title: Number of Islands

examples.body:
```text
[["1","1","0"],
 ["1","1","0"],
 ["0","0","1"]]
```

has two islands: the 2-by-2 block in the upper left and the lone cell in the lower right.

constraints: The grid has between 1 and 300 rows and between 1 and 300 columns.
Cells connect only up, down, left, and right.
